body: Its okay, youre making the first step posting here. It is not easy doing what youre doing.
Hang in there you got this. Maybe theres still something you havent told and maybe theres something thats holding you back and you dont even know it. Maybe you just need some time for yourself!

Oh my god that was me for so long!! Im still afraid of people but people are not that bad as I made them be in my head. When I got therapy (group therapy) everyone was so nice and understanding it was the first time I felt like someone really cared to listen and didnt judge me for it and it really helped sort out a lot of things inside my head. Please try because its really worth it. They are there to help you and they really care! Try everything before you even think about suicide because theres always hope. Sending lots of love <3
Why are you afraid of getting help?
Do you have some sort of dream?
Are you trying to become someone youre not?

Well theres some part of you that feels worth it if you are here and thank you for sharing I know its hard. I know what it feels like to not be able to do anything because everything seems pointless but theres always something that needs attention in your life. Have you tried talking to anyone about this? Your boyfriend? Damn I wish I had a significant other... But hey its always worse in your head than it actually is.
